louis_bypass_bypasses: garage_entry_beam (security beam / ambush challenge), not the keypad
mission_title: Parmida vs. The Neon Drive-Thru (Working Title)
mission_fantasy_one_liner: Parmida uses sprint, stealth, dodge, clues, scheme cards, and questionable Louis intel to complete a ridiculous Taco Bell delivery-heist and escape clean.
player_goal: Complete the delivery objective chain, survive the garage security beat (code + beam), optionally collect evidence, and return to exit / hideout.

objective_sequence.text: Reach the Taco Bell delivery zone entrance.
Talk to Louis — get dubious but useful routing intel.
Locate the pickup / order staging point.
Clear a low-risk teaching obstacle (light/camera read-only or scent trail).
Navigate a timing / stealth pressure segment without mandatory combat.
Open the staff code gate (keypad) — separate from beam zone.
Survive or mitigate the garage entry security beam (one alarm trigger per attempt).
Optional: use Louis shortcut to skip beam-zone penalty path while still recovering bag.
Use aimed poop-bag throws to create distractions where surfaces support it.
Recover the delivery bag evidence / payload.
Optional: collect polaroids / clues for humor and scheme hooks.
Reach exit with completion conditions; return to hideout via mission result flow.

failure_conditions: Player health depleted if combat enabled
Hard fail only if D5 adds explicit fail triggers — default: soft retry via reload
completion_conditions: Phase0K exit requirements met: delivery bag + code gate (current code) OR D5 revises contract with documented acceptance
Mission completion call through GameState/SceneManager succeeds
reset_retry_rules: Attempt-local flags in IsoMissionBase._attempt_runtime_state cleared on _reset_attempt_runtime_state; D5 must align QuestManager + Phase0K seeds on same boundary; full mission reload remains primary retry vehicle per IsoMissionBase comment
